description: Edit an agent's live runtime configuration — greeting/first message, inbound or SMS prompt, voice, language model, max call duration, and call-transfer settings — routed through the governed update broker so every change keeps the consent + audit trail (a versioned config snapshot and change history). Every write here is reversible: get_change_history and list_config_versions list what changed, and rollback_config undoes it. Mutating changes need an idempotency_key. When the business owner or an admin is signed in through this connector, their own changes apply immediately. High-impact live changes made with an API key or on someone else's behalf queue for the owner's review instead (the owner is notified with a review link). configure_agent_business_rules edits a single named operational-rules section.

actor.description: Who is asking: { type: agent|human|system|integration, id, display_name }.

authority.description: Attribution only. Caller-supplied authority cannot authorize live changes; authenticated owner review of the stored request is required.

business_id.description: Business ID. Required when the agent has multiple accessible assignments.

dry_run.description: Validate and summarize the change without writing.

first_message.description: Spoken greeting / first message callers hear.

idempotency_key.description: Required for writes. Reuse the same key when retrying the same change.

inbound_prompt.description: Full inbound system prompt that drives the agent.

model.description: Language model selection: { provider, model, temperature }.

queue_for_approval.description: When authority is missing, create a pending dashboard approval instead of returning needs_approval.

source_ref.description: External source reference, such as a support ticket or conversation ID.

transfer_phone_number.description: Number to transfer qualified calls to.

name: update_agent_config
title: Update Agent Configuration
